notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Just a heads-up as to what's added in the latest update -

# Zombie-slaying variables now carry over their value to a re-rolled game
# Implemented a notification when character begins to starve
# Implemented a choice system on random notes found throughout the streets
# Starvation slows the longer you play the game
# Zombies now drop loots
# Added a couple of battle backgrounds
# Added Achievement Notification Graphics

Enjoy!
